messages:
Priya (CS Ops): heads up — saw a burst of auto_renewal_offer messages go out to ~83 trial accounts overnight. many look like they haven't touched the product in >180d.
Noah (Data Eng): ugh, that's bad. any sample acct ids?
Priya (CS Ops): ACC-81222 ACC-82001 ACC-82399 — pulled from the outbound log.
Priya (CS Ops): outbound log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T02:01:12Z | auto_renewal_offer | ACC-81222 | template:v2
2026-03-20T02:01:13Z | auto_renewal_offer | ACC-82001 | template:v2
```
Tess (CS Tools): I temporarily disabled rule: automation:auto_renewal_offer (paused) — will keep paused until we confirm root cause.
Alert Bot: Automation pause recorded by Tess at 2026-03-20T02:15:03Z — reason: suspected bad healthscore inputs.
Ava (Success Manager): thanks. I'm getting inbound from two CSMs about confused customers. can we mark VIPs so they stop seeing the offer?
Noah (Data Eng): quick theory: recent CRM import has inconsistent values in `last_active` free-text field. some rows have "never"/"n/a" which our parser previously mapped to 0 days -> healthscore recency multiplier = 1.8 -> inflated scores.
Noah (Data Eng): example dirty rows:
```
account_id | last_active
ACC-81222  | never
ACC-82001  | N/A
ACC-82399  | 2025-09-10
```
Priya (CS Ops): that fits — these should be treated as NULL/unknown, not 0. can we normalise and recompute healthscore?
Noah (Data Eng): yes. plan: 1) patch parser to map ['never','n/a','-'] -> NULL; 2) backfill normalised last_active; 3) recompute healthscore for affected accounts; 4) re-run outbound eligibility.
Noah (Data Eng): backfill SQL (run after parser deploy):
```
UPDATE crm.accounts
SET last_active_parsed = NULL
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(last_active)) IN ('never','n/a','-','unknown')
AND updated_at > '2026-03-15';

-- recompute simplified healthscore for impacted accounts
UPDATE crm.accounts a
SET healthscore = (COALESCE(a.product_usage_score,20) * (CASE WHEN a.last_active_parsed IS NULL THEN 0.6 ELSE 1.0 END))
WHERE updated_at > '2026-03-15'
AND LOWER(TRIM(a.last_active)) IN ('never','n/a','-','unknown');
```
Tess (CS Tools): I'm rolling a small patch to the importer with the normalisation rules to staging now. will not promote until backfill dry-run looks good.
Deploy Bot: Importer v3.7 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T03:02:44Z — succeeded
Noah (Data Eng): ran dry-run on staging; recompute corrected sample accounts: ACC-81222 healthscore 28 -> 16, ACC-82001 30 -> 18. looks right.
Tess (CS Tools): queued backfill in prod (job id: 0x5a7). ETA ~18m. logs: https://logs.internal/backfills/0x5a7
Priya (CS Ops): I started a quick cohort check dashboard to see outbound eligibility changes. pausing any scheduled automation sends for that cohort until we verify.
Ava (Success Manager): flagged VIPs ACC-82001 and ACC-83012 for manual outreach. I'll send them a personal note instead of the automated offer.
Deploy Bot: Backfill job 0x5a7 started at 2026-03-20T03:25:10Z
Tess (CS Tools): backfill finished. runtime 19m. no apparent errors in logs.
Noah (Data Eng): recompute finished. delta: 83 accounts changed eligibility -> removed from outbound. rolling 6h watch on outbound counts and healthscore histogram.
Priya (CS Ops): verified outbound log: no auto_renewal_offer for those 83 accounts after backfill. good catch team.
Ava (Success Manager): manual outreach done for VIPs. one reply asked why they got the earlier email — I've logged a short apology and explained it's a system error.
Tess (CS Tools): re-enabling automation at 2026-03-20T05:00Z with a 2-hour soft-monitoring window. will revert if any anomalies.
Priya (CS Ops): closing thread: root cause = free-text last_active normalization bug in CRM importer; fix deployed + backfill applied + automations resumed with monitoring. thanks everyone. :wave:
